sources.cite: AWS Certified Security - Specialty (SCS-C03) exam guide: Detection 16%, Incident Response 14%, Infrastructure Security 18%, Identity and Access Management 20%, Data Protection 18%, Security Foundations and Governance 14%

sources.cite: AWS Certification, AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Professional certification page (current exam SAP-C03), and Tutorials Dojo, 'What's new with the AWS Certified Solutions Architect Professional SAP-C03'
sources.note: Both read through summarizing fetches on 2026-11-17. The AWS page links the SAP-C03 exam guide and prep plan but shows no domains. The Tutorials Dojo page lists the five SAP-C03 domains (cloud-native architecture design and implementation; security, compliance, and governance; cost-optimized architecture design; resilience, migration, and business continuity; operational excellence and automation) and says SAP-C03 became generally available on November 17, 2026. The weights (25/25/15/15/20) and the objective wording are the course seed's; the official SAP-C03 guide was not read (to verify).

sources.cite: AWS KMS Developer Guide, Allowing users in other accounts to use a KMS key
sources.note: Read through a summarizing fetch on 2026-11-17. Quoted: 'Neither the key policy nor the IAM policy alone is sufficient - you must change both'; the key policy in the owning account must give the external account (or its roles) permission; IAM policies in the external account delegate it, and can only grant actions the key policy also allows. That automatic rotation keeps earlier key material so older objects still decrypt, and that an AWS managed key's policy cannot be changed, are from memory of the KMS guide (to verify).
